scenes.name: THE BALL
lines: A qubit is a point in a ball. Pure states sit on its skin, mixed states inside.
一个量子比特是球里的一个点：纯态在球皮上，混合态在球里面。
Noise is the environment touching it, and each noise moves the whole ball at once.
噪声是环境碰了它一下；每一种噪声都一次挪动整颗球。
So watch the ball. Can noise ever pull two states further apart?
所以盯着球看：噪声能不能把两个态拉得更远？

scenes.name: SQUEEZE TO THE AXIS
lines: Write the state as a matrix. Pinching keeps the diagonal and erases the rest.
把态写成矩阵：捏合保留对角元，抹掉其余两个。
On the ball, every point slides sideways onto the vertical axis.
在球上，每个点都横着滑到竖轴上。
Here the squared size is one: zero point eight two kept, zero point one eight thrown away.
这里的平方大小是 1：留下 0.82，丢掉 0.18。
Lean checks this split for every two by two matrix: what is thrown away is the off-diagonal mass.
Lean 内核检验：任何 2×2 矩阵都这样一分为二，丢掉的正是非对角元的模平方和。
Real dephasing goes step by step, multiplying the off-diagonal by c. The ball slims into a cigar.
真实的相位阻尼一步一步来，每步把非对角元乘以 c；球瘦成一根雪茄。

scenes.name: SHRINK AND RISE
lines: Energy loss is different: the qubit falls toward the ground state at the north pole.
能量耗散不一样：比特往北极的基态跌落。
At gamma zero point three six, heights are scaled by zero point six four and raised by zero point three six; widths shrink to zero point eight.
The south pole climbs to minus zero point two eight. The north pole stays put.
南极爬到 −0.28；北极纹丝不动。

scenes.name: HOW WIDE
lines: Fix the north pole and the height rule. How wide may the image be?
北极不动，高度规则也不变：像最多能有多宽？
Follow one point. Width zero point eight keeps it inside; width zero point nine pushes it out.
盯住一个点：宽度因子 0.8，它还在球里；0.9，就刺出了球皮。
Lean checks the exact rule: the whole ball stays inside if and only if the width squared is at most the height factor.
Lean 内核检验：整颗球不出界，当且仅当宽度因子的平方不超过高度因子。
Zero point eight squared is zero point six four: energy loss sits exactly on the edge.
0.8² = 0.64：能量耗散恰好压在边界上。

scenes.name: NEVER FARTHER
lines: How far apart are two states? Half the straight distance between their points.
两个态相距多远？量两点之间直线距离的一半。
This pair starts zero point eight apart. Pinching leaves it at zero point eight.
这一对起初相距 0.8；捏合之后还是 0.8。
Energy loss brings it to zero point five one two.
经过能量耗散，只剩 0.512。
Lean checks that every quantum channel does this: distance never grows.
Lean 内核检验：任何量子信道都是这样，距离从不变大。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Never grows is not always shrinks: a rotation keeps every distance.
“从不变大”不等于“一定变小”：转动一下，所有距离都不变。
Staying inside the ball is one test; a quantum channel must pass more.
留在球里只是一道检验；量子信道还得过更多关。
And the ball pictures of the named noises are textbook results, not formalized in this book.
各种噪声在球上的样子是教科书结果，本书没有形式化。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter four.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第四章
